title: Skill Alchemy
wikitext:
Alchemy allows the practitioner to combine ingredients to create potions with various effects, enabling the user to "cast" spells not normally available to them. Alchemy isn't exactly cheap- Learning the trade can cost lots of time and platinum. Choosing to pursue alchemy to its maximum can be very expensive, but it does have rewards in the end. == Getting Started == If you have the skill points, you may want to visit one of your class Guildmasters to train Alchemy up to 20, saving a few combines at the beginning. Buy a [[Medicine Bag]] from a vendor, or obtain a [[Reinforced Medicine Bag]] (made via [[Tailoring]] from a [[Thick Grizzly Bear Skin]] and a [[Silk Cord]]). Next, you'll need to buy the correct ingredients for the potion you want to make. Let's say you want to make a "[[Potion of Lesser Stability]]". This potion requires combining [[Lucerne]] and [[Sage Leaf]] in your Medicine Bag. It becomes trivial to make (granting no further skill increases) at skill 25. If you trained 20 points into Alchemy, and as tradeskill success depends on the comparison of your skill to the created item's trivial, the chance of successfully making this potion are rather good. '''Skilling Up:'''
'''Intelligence or Wisdom, whichever is higher, governs your chance to gain skill increases.''' == Recipes == These are the recipes available in EverQuest Legends. Some are not necessarily from the "original" or "classic" era, but the ingredients are available, the recipes combine, and they are visible in the trivial list inside the [[Medicine Bag]] or [[Reinforced Medicine Bag]]. '''Please note''' that the [[Medicine Bag]] only has 6 slots for combining, so any recipe with more than 6 ingredients requires the [[Reinforced Medicine Bag]]! === Recipes listed by trivial ===
